accessions: GSE87748 (RNA-seq SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE87749, S5.p1)
assay: total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), human vastus lateralis, HiSeq 2500 SR100
primary_estimand: within-subject change in skeletal-muscle gene expression 4 h after one 15-min bout of cycling at 80% VO2max vs resting basal biopsy, in 10 sedentary young men
inclusion: 10 male volunteers, biopsies at rest (basal) and 4 h post-exercise (S2.1.p1); all 20 samples deposited
planned_contrasts: post-exercise (240 min) vs basal (S3.1.p1; paper: 165 DEGs, 72 up / 93 down, of 6,242 genes tested)
normalization: featureCounts gene coverage; filter > 2.5 RPKM in >= 5 samples (S2.3.p1)
paper_method: edgeR glmQLFit/glmQLFTest (S2.3.p1; GEO data_processing edgeR v3.12.1); paired vs unpaired design not stated
paper_results: 165 DEGs (72 up, 93 down); NR4A3 top up (FC 26, FDR 2.51e-5); Table 1 top-10 up genes
